full_judgment: 3. In that suit defendant filed an application under Order VII Rule 11(d) read with Section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure alleging that the predecessor of defendant Nos.1-3 had instituted Other Class Suit No.235 of 1972 before the then Munsif, Cox's Bazar impleading the predecessor of defendant No.4 and others for declaration of their title on the self-same land and for khas possession. The said suit was decreed on contest on 31.7.1986 and that the predecessor of the defendant No. 4 and others had filed Other Appeal No.144 of 1986 in the Court of District Judge, Cox's Bazar. Ultimately the Subordinate Judge, Cox's Bazar after hearing, by judgment and decree dated 17.3.1987 allowed the appeal and thereby set aside the judgment and decree passed by the trial Court. Thereafter, the defendants and their predecessor filed Civil Revision No.562 of 1987 before the High Court Division and obtained Rule, which upon hearing was made absolute and the Title Suit No. 235 of 1972 was decreed. The predecessor of the present plaintiffs after 6 years filed Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No.870 of 2009 before this Division, and after hearing, by judgment and order dated 12.11.2009 the petition was dismissed. Hence, the defendants of the instant suit filed the application for rejection of the plaint as being barred by law.
